assumptions.statement: Submitted site boundary and key-area polygons use repository provisional rough geometry, not official redline data.
assumptions.impact: Spatial diagrams and metrics are valid only for concept discussion, intake review and recalculation workflow; they must be recomputed after official GIS/CAD polygons are released.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA geometry becomes available.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, heritage-control geometry, municipal utilities and engineering constraints are not included in the public cleared package.
assumptions.impact: The proposal gives urban-design and operation suggestions only; it does not assert FAR, height, demolition, road alignment or utility capacity conclusions.

assumptions.statement: No verified site-scale thermal-comfort, wind, shade, tree-canopy or pedestrian-flow dataset is available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Noonline SLA is framed as a service-level design and testing protocol; comfort thresholds must be calibrated through professional field monitoring before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Haidian 2020 census statistics are district-wide and dated 2020.
assumptions.impact: They justify inclusive service checks for mixed users, older people and visitors; they do not prove the project-site population composition or midday demand in 2026.

assumptions.statement: No personal-location, face, mobile-signaling, payment, private company or non-cleared operational records are used.
assumptions.impact: AI service scenarios must rely on aggregated, opt-in, anonymized or public operational data and keep visible human fallback.

assumptions.statement: SLA-A, SLA-B and SLA-C are three observable service-level path types organized on the existing ROAD-001 midday spine and drawings, not three separate surveyed road-centerline features.
assumptions.impact: Each SLA level is judged by spatial conditions such as shade continuity, rest, water, public entry, crossing waiting, summer detour and staffed fallback; detailed thresholds require field survey before implementation.

assumptions.statement: The 12 service nodes and 5 staffed fallback points are concept locations selected by endpoint, turning, staying, crossing, public-entry, heat/rain-risk and event-flow rules.
assumptions.impact: They explain the Round 1 urban-design network and visual package; they are not existing facility inventories and must be surveyed before construction or operation.
